title: Controlling fuel injection pumps
definition: Control of fuel injection pumps for combustion engines, including general and low-pressure injection control.
text: F02D 1/00. Controlling fuel injection pumps for combustion engines; general and low-pressure fuel injection control.

title: Controlling low-pressure fuel injection
definition: Control of low-pressure fuel injection systems for combustion engines.
text: F02D 3/00. Controlling low-pressure fuel injection in combustion engines.

title: Controlling fuel injection by other means
definition: Control of fuel injection for combustion engines by means not covered by the preceding groups.
text: F02D 7/00. Controlling fuel injection by other means in combustion engines.

title: Controlling engines by throttling
definition: Control of combustion engines by throttling air, fuel-and-air induction, or exhaust.
text: F02D 9/00. Controlling combustion engines by throttling air or fuel-and-air induction or exhaust.

title: Non-automatic engine control initiation
definition: Initiating engine control manually or by an operator.
text: F02D 11/00. Non-automatic initiation of combustion-engine control, for example by an operator.

title: Controlling the valve-operating cycle
definition: Control of combustion engines by varying or managing the valve-operating cycle.
text: F02D 13/00. Controlling combustion engines by acting on the valve-operating cycle.

title: Varying compression ratio
definition: Control of combustion engines by changing their compression ratio.
text: F02D 15/00. Controlling combustion engines by varying the compression ratio.

title: Cutting out cylinders or idling engines
definition: Control by cutting out cylinders, rendering engines inoperative, or causing idling.
text: F02D 17/00. Cutting out cylinders, rendering combustion engines inoperative, or controlling idling.

title: Control based on fuel characteristics
definition: Control of combustion engines characterised by the type or characteristics of fuel used.
text: F02D 19/00. Controlling particular combustion engines characterised by the fuel used.

title: Control based on combustion medium
definition: Control of combustion engines characterised by the combustion medium used.
text: F02D 21/00. Controlling particular engines characterised by the combustion medium used.

title: Control of supercharged engines
definition: Control of combustion engines characterised by supercharging or turbocharging.
text: F02D 23/00. Controlling supercharged or turbocharged combustion engines.

title: Control of cooperating engines
definition: Control arrangements for two or more engines that cooperate.
text: F02D 25/00. Controlling two or more cooperating combustion engines.

title: Control of reversible engines
definition: Control arrangements for reversible combustion engines.
text: F02D 27/00. Controlling reversible combustion engines.

title: Program control of engines
definition: Programmed or sequence-based control of combustion engines.
text: F02D 28/00. Programme control of combustion engines.

title: Control of engines driving vehicles or devices
definition: Control of combustion engines that drive vehicles or particular machines and devices.
text: F02D 29/00. Controlling combustion engines driving vehicles or particular devices.

title: Speed-responsive engine control
definition: Automatic initiation or actuation of engine control by speed-sensing governors.
text: F02D 31/00. Automatic engine control initiated by speed-sensing governors.

title: Control of fuel or combustion-air delivery
definition: Control of fuel or combustion-air delivery not otherwise provided for.
text: F02D 33/00. Controlling delivery of fuel or combustion air, not otherwise provided for.

title: Control responsive to operating conditions
definition: Automatic engine control initiated by internal or external conditions such as temperature, pressure, load, or speed.
text: F02D 35/00. Automatic combustion-engine control responsive to interior or exterior conditions, including temperature, pressure, load, and speed sensors.

title: Control of multiple engine functions
definition: Control acting on two or more associated combustion-engine functions not otherwise provided for.
text: F02D 37/00. Controlling two or more associated combustion-engine functions.

title: Non-electrical engine control
definition: Non-electrical control arrangements for combustion engines.
text: F02D 39/00. Non-electrical control of combustion engines.

title: Electrical control of combustion engines
definition: Electrical or electronic control of combustion-engine operation, including control units using sensor inputs.
text: F02D 41/00. Electrical and electronic control of combustion engines using control units and sensor signals.

title: Electrical control of multiple functions
definition: Electrical control of two or more combustion-engine functions such as injection, ignition, throttle, or air supply.
text: F02D 43/00. Electrical control of two or more combustion-engine functions, including injection, ignition, and air supply.

title: Electrical control not otherwise provided for
definition: Electrical control of combustion engines and related monitoring not covered by other F02D groups.
text: F02D 45/00. Electrical control of combustion engines not otherwise provided for, including monitoring and diagnostics.
